verdicts.title: Cohomological aspects on complex and symplectic manifolds
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We discuss how quantitative cohomological informations could provide qualitative properties on complex and symplectic manifolds. verdicts.title: Tamed Symplectic forms and SKT metrics
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Symplectic forms taming complex structures on compact manifolds are strictly related to Hermitian metrics having the fundamental form $\partial \bar \partial $-closed, i.e. to strong Kähler with torsion (${\rm SKT}$) metrics.
